title: Capabilities, tool contracts, and bounded execution
note: Authority here is an OBJECT, not a flag: each mutation removes one dimension a grant is bounded along (subject, task, tool, action, scope, revocation, expiry) or one bound execution is held to (deadline, cancellation, memory, output, process group, environment). The three outcomes that are not success -- TIMED_OUT, CANCELLED, DENIED -- have their own mutations, because collapsing any of them into COMPLETED is the failure that would matter most.

mutations.name: K1_subject_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a grant becomes a bearer token any actor can present

mutations.name: K2_task_confinement_removed
mutations.rationale: a component tricked into acting on another task's behalf succeeds

mutations.name: K3_action_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a read grant authorizes writes

mutations.name: K4_tool_binding_removed
mutations.find: if cap.action is Action.EXECUTE_TOOL and cap.tool_id != req.tool_id:
mutations.rationale: a grant for one tool runs any tool

mutations.name: K7_expiry_ignored

mutations.name: K8_unknown_capability_accepted
mutations.rationale: a grant that was never issued authorizes work -- unforgeability gone

mutations.name: K9_root_scope_accepted
mutations.rationale: a scope of '.' silently grants the entire repository

mutations.name: K11_absolute_scope_accepted
mutations.rationale: a grant means something different on each host

mutations.name: K12_empty_scope_accepted
mutations.rationale: an empty allowlist is treated as policy, not a mistake

mutations.rationale: a grant that was never valid is issued

mutations.find: if action is Action.EXECUTE_TOOL and not tool_id:
mutations.rationale: a grant to run 'some tool' is a grant to run any tool

mutations.name: T2_registry_not_frozen
mutations.rationale: a tool appears at runtime that nobody reviewed

mutations.name: T3_undeclared_fields_accepted
mutations.rationale: unvalidated content arrives through a contract claiming completeness

mutations.name: T4_bool_passes_as_int
mutations.rationale: a flag silently becomes a count

mutations.name: T5_required_fields_optional
mutations.rationale: a tool runs without an input its contract requires

mutations.name: T7_untimeoutable_tool_registered

mutations.rationale: a tool that cannot time out cannot be cancelled

mutations.name: T8_scoped_writes_without_scope
mutations.rationale: the scope that makes writes scoped is optional

mutations.name: X1_success_predicate_always_true
mutations.rationale: every outcome including TIMED_OUT and DENIED reads as success

mutations.name: X2_successful_set_widened
mutations.rationale: a timed-out run is treated as having produced a usable result

mutations.name: X3_failed_becomes_retryable
mutations.rationale: a deterministic rejection is retried until it becomes a load problem

mutations.name: X4_deadline_never_fires
mutations.rationale: a hung tool runs forever

mutations.name: X7_capability_not_checked_before_running
mutations.rationale: any actor runs any registered tool

mutations.name: X8_environment_inherited
mutations.rationale: the child inherits credentials, proxies and paths nobody granted it

mutations.name: X9_no_process_group
mutations.rationale: an orphaned grandchild outlives the timeout that killed its parent

mutations.name: X10_no_output_limit
mutations.rationale: a runaway producer is bounded only by what the reader keeps

mutations.name: X11_no_memory_limit
mutations.rationale: a memory bomb runs to completion

mutations.name: X13_temp_output_files_leak
mutations.rationale: every run leaves its stdout and stderr behind

mutations.name: X14_inputs_not_validated
mutations.rationale: a tool runs on inputs its contract rejects

mutations.name: L1_ledger_ignores_revocation
mutations.rationale: a revoked grant keeps working; revocation becomes a log entry with no effect

mutations.name: L3_ledger_loads_an_unverified_log
mutations.rationale: grants are projected from a history that may have been rewritten

mutations.name: L4_ledger_issue_does_not_append
mutations.find:
ev = self.log.append(actor=actor, action=ACT_ISSUE,
                             target=cap.task_id,
                             payload={"task_id": cap.task_id, **cap.body()})
        self.apply(ev)
        return self._issued[cap.capability_id]
mutations.rationale: THE DEFECT THE LEDGER CLOSES: a grant held only in memory authorizes work, and the log never recorded it

mutations.name: L5_ledger_reuses_an_existing_id
mutations.rationale: issuing over a live id silently replaces a grant others may already be citing
